title: BME-X
paper_title: A Foundation Model for Enhancing Magnetic Resonance Images and Downstream Segmentation, Registration and Diagnostic Tasks
core_mech: BME-X 不是通用 MRI encoder，而是先预测组织标签、再用组织感知 DU-Net 生成增强图像的两阶段恢复模型。
core_mech_en: Two-stage brain MRI enhancement foundation model that first estimates tissue probability maps and then conditions a Dual U-Net (DU-Net) to restore harmonized images.
input_desc: 受运动、低分辨率、噪声、扫描仪或场强差异影响的结构脑 MRI
input_en: Structural brain MRI degraded by motion, low resolution, noise, or cross-scanner field-strength shifts
output_desc: 高质量、组织强度更一致的增强 MRI，可供分割、配准与诊断
output_en: Harmonized, artifact-corrected, high-resolution brain MRI ready for downstream morphometry, registration, and diagnosis
gaps: The original BME-X implementation is linked and pinned; its complete multimodal learning workflow has not been converted into a tested low-resource adapter.
